title: Clockmaker's Rehearsal
provenance: Original Postern rehearsal authored 27 September 2026. Fictional mechanisms; not Wrenmere canon. Difficulty is not human-calibrated.

intro.storyOn: Three demonstration dials have stopped on their index marks. The clockmaker’s service hatch is driven by the same spring, but only when the train is routed away from the hands. Nothing here runs against real time.
intro.storyOff: Find the unique turn setting from 0 through 59 that aligns three cyclic dials. Then restore the spring and route its energy to the maintenance hatch. This counter is a discrete input model, not a real timer.

ending.storyOn: The spring releases into the maintenance linkage and the hatch opens. You found the common alignment inside the stated interval, then restored the mechanical route that could use it.
ending.storyOff: The spring releases into the maintenance linkage and the hatch opens. You found the common alignment inside the stated interval, then restored the mechanical route that could use it.

solution.storyOn: Find t from 0 to 59 with remainders 1 mod 3, 2 mod 4 and 4 mod 5. The only value is 34. Enter 34 to open the spring case. Take and install the spring, wind it, select Index instead of Run and release the service hatch. Removing the spring relaxes it; it can always be installed and wound again.
solution.storyOff: Find t from 0 to 59 with remainders 1 mod 3, 2 mod 4 and 4 mod 5. The only value is 34. Enter 34 to open the spring case. Take and install the spring, wind it, select Index instead of Run and release the service hatch. Removing the spring relaxes it; it can always be installed and wound again.

text.storyOn: All dials start at zero; each simulated turn advances each by one, wrapping at its cycle length. Dial A cycles through 0, 1, 2 and must show 1. B cycles through 0, 1, 2, 3 and must show 2. C cycles through 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and must show 4. The allowed counter interval is 0 through 59 inclusive.
text.storyOff: All dials start at zero; each simulated turn advances each by one, wrapping at its cycle length. Dial A cycles through 0, 1, 2 and must show 1. B cycles through 0, 1, 2, 3 and must show 2. C cycles through 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and must show 4. The allowed counter interval is 0 through 59 inclusive.

text.storyOn: Enter a whole turn count in the stated interval. A matching alignment opens the spring case. Wrong inputs leave the room unchanged; use scratch notes to compare candidate counts.
text.storyOff: Enter a whole turn count in the stated interval. A matching alignment opens the spring case. Wrong inputs leave the room unchanged; use scratch notes to compare candidate counts.

text.storyOn: The index marks have not been matched.
text.storyOff: The index marks have not been matched.

text.storyOn: All three index marks align; the spring case opens.
text.storyOff: All three index marks align; the spring case opens.

text.storyOn: The spring is removable and reusable. Its service label says: Run drives the clock hands; Index drives the maintenance hatch.
text.storyOff: The spring is removable and reusable. Its service label says: Run drives the clock hands; Index drives the maintenance hatch.

text.storyOn: One spring rests in the case.
text.storyOff: One spring rests in the case.

text.storyOn: The spring is fitted to the train.
text.storyOff: The spring is fitted to the train.

text.storyOn: An installed spring can be wound or relaxed. Removing it relaxes its tension. Choose where its energy should go before trying the service release.
text.storyOff: An installed spring can be wound or relaxed. Removing it relaxes its tension. Choose where its energy should go before trying the service release.

text.storyOn: Try the service release when the train is ready. Incorrect setups consume nothing.
text.storyOff: Try the service release when the train is ready. Incorrect setups consume nothing.
